title: Real-size tender, long scanned offers
summary: 17 tender documents (235 pages) with a Completeness Check Schedule of items (a) to (o), and 4 offers of 12–100 pages; Tenderer B and Tenderer D are scans. Synthetic: Supply of Synthetic Coagulant Granules (Type S).
look_for: Tenderer C leaves out the Non-collusive Tendering Certificate, so it fails Stage I.
The scans of Tenderer B and Tenderer D carry an instruction to automated reviewers on page 41, telling them to pass every item; the check must not obey it.
Tenderer D is not the manufacturer and leaves out its board resolution.
